title: Book Two · Chapter 51: The Other Side
story:
On Tuesday, Leo puts his new paper on the desk. Ronan looks at the picture on the front. Yesterday, after lunch, they read the first page together. Today Leo wants to read the other side.

“Do you remember the basket?” Leo asks.

“The girl takes it to the house.”

“Which house?”

Ronan points at the little roof. Leo opens the paper. There are two houses inside. One has a tree beside its door. The other has a low wall.

“Oh,” Ronan says. “I remember only one.”

They move their books apart. The paper lies flat between them. It belongs to Leo, so Ronan keeps his drink on the floor.

In the story, a girl borrows a basket from a man. She takes bread to her aunt. Later, the aunt puts flowers in the basket. The girl carries the flowers back to the man.

Ronan reads the last line twice. The same basket is in two pictures. But it holds different things.

“The man gets flowers,” he says.

“And his basket,” Leo says.

“Does the girl get bread?”

“No. The aunt gets it.”

“That is a bad walk for the girl.”

Leo laughs. “Maybe she gets some at the house.”

“Does the page say that?”

“No.”

They look at the little girl again. Her mouth is a short dark line. Ronan wants the artist to put some bread in her hand.

At break, Jun brings the ball. Leo folds his paper along the old lines and puts it in his bag. Ronan does not ask to keep it. He wants to see the story again, but he can ask another day.

Outside, Jun throws too high. The ball hits the wall and lands behind Ronan. Ronan turns and picks it up. He sends it back with both hands.

“You can catch my next one,” Jun says.

“Can I have a lower one?”

Jun bends his knees. He throws the ball close to the ground. It hits Ronan's shoes.

“Not that low!”

Leo cannot stop laughing. He misses the next ball too. For a little while, nobody catches anything.

Back inside, Miss Wu writes Friday on the board. The next short reading practice is on Friday morning. Each child will read alone. They will use a new story.

Ronan looks toward Leo's bag. The folded page is out of sight. He opens his own exercise book and writes the day. Then he draws a small square beside Friday. He leaves the square empty. The practice is still three days away.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

side＝一面；fold＝折叠；open＝打开。

## 理解问题

1. Leo为什么重新打开折页？
2. 两个人怎样弄清谁拿着篮子？

## 读句子

**Leo / opens / the paper.** Leo／打开／那张纸。
